gaps.quote: the updates $D\gets D-H$, $H\gets H+D$, $D\gets H-D$ send
gaps.note: The page calls H, D chunk values, then says they become vectors of m fields over Z/q^bZ. The three updates give (D,H) only if all three act componentwise on the m fields (as the paper says, 'componentwise', line 1538). On whole chunk values as numbers mod q^e, subtraction carries between fields and would not match the vector shear H+MD used later. The page never states the componentwise hypothesis.

gaps.quote: splitting, merging, gates and scheduling cost $O(V)$ here
gaps.note: The page asserts that running s recursive calls on fixed tapes costs only O(V) extra at each node, with W role streams parked and restored. It gives no argument; the paper devotes a separate depth-first schedule paragraph to it (lines 1559-1588). The reader cannot check it, and F_0=O(1) is likewise asserted with no base-case justification.
